text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria further support this. Low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
